items.quote: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
items.claim: The priests are prohibited from leaving the tabernacle door
items.place: door of the tabernacle of the congregation

items.quote: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you
items.claim: The LORD has anointed the priests with sacred oil

items.quote: And they did according to the word of Moses
items.claim: The priests complied with the command of Moses
